تستكفون (form X)
# تَسْتَكِفُّونَ (tastakiffūna) /tas.ta.kif.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَكَفَّ (istakaffa)
# تُسْتَكَفُّونَ (tustakaffūna) /tus.ta.kaf.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَكَفَّ (istakaffa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
